findings.title: Security (surface 5): injection
findings.body:
Reachability: Feishu event field event.message.content is decoded at service/feishu_finance_agent.go:319 into `text`, persisted as RawText at service/feishu_finance_agent.go:334, passed to parseFeishuFinanceAgentCommand at service/feishu_finance_agent.go:359, embedded verbatim as the LLM user message at service/feishu_finance_agent_client.go:286, and POSTed to the configured LLM endpoint at service/feishu_finance_agent_client.go:349; the model's structured output becomes the plan that, after card confirmation, is executed by executeFeishuFinanceAgentPlan via model.AddAffPromotionUsers and model.GrantAdminCredits.
Note: Prompt injection into the instruction-parsing LLM: chat text (group messages or third-party content pasted by the operator, both explicitly treated as untrusted in the file's own threat-model comment) reaches the model unescaped, and the model output is converted into privileged writes (promotion enrollment, per-user commission rate, withdrawal switch, credit grants up to 1,000,000 per action). Mitigations present but not breaking the path: sender must be whitelisted and still Root at both message and confirm time (authorizeFeishuFinanceAgentOperator), target account must appear verbatim in the raw text (feishuFinanceAgentTargetMentioned), numeric bounds are clamped server-side (buildFeishuFinanceAgentPlan), and the confirm card shows the raw text plus injection warnings (feishuFinanceAgentInjectionWarningText).
findings.recommendation: Fix the issue, or provide evidence that the path is not reachable.

findings.title: Security (surface 7): SSRF
findings.body:
Reachability: env var FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_OPENAPI_BASE read at setting/feishu_finance_agent_setting.go:32 (os.Getenv -> FeishuFinanceAgentSetting.OpenAPIBase) -> setting.GetFeishuFinanceAgentSetting() at service/feishu_finance_agent_ws.go:35 -> cfg passed to runFeishuFinanceAgentWS -> runFeishuFinanceAgentWSSession -> feishuFinanceAgentWSDomain(cfg.OpenAPIBase) at line 101 (service/feishu_finance_agent_ws.go:111-119 only trims whitespace/"/open-apis", no host allowlist or scheme validation) -> larkws.WithDomain(domain) at line 102 -> larkws.NewClient(cfg.AppID, cfg.AppSecret, opts...) at line 105 -> client.Start at line 106 dials an outbound WebSocket to the env-chosen host
Note: The long-connection endpoint is taken verbatim from an environment variable with no allowlist or scheme/host validation. A malicious or misconfigured FEISHU_FINANCE_AGENT_OPENAPI_BASE makes the process open an outbound WebSocket to an arbitrary host, and the SDK hands the Feishu AppID/AppSecret to that host during connection setup (credential exfiltration), after which all IM/card events that drive credit grants and commission changes are supplied by the attacker-chosen endpoint. The source is deployment environment configuration rather than remote user input, which bounds real-world likelihood; the comment '本地冒烟可指向假服务' shows this is an intentional but unvalidated override knob.
findings.recommendation: Fix the issue, or provide evidence that the path is not reachable.
